stories.title: Ex-Durham police recruit pleads guilty in sex assault case involving 2 teen girls
stories.summary: William Knight, 33, pleaded guilty to two counts of sexual assault and one count of making child pornography in a downtown courtroom Friday.

stories.title: Stelco to recall 175 laid-off workers in Hamilton, Ont. on Dec. 1
stories.summary: Stelco is recalling 175 temporarily laid off workers as it plans to restart its Hamilton, Ont., finishing operations on Dec. 1.

stories.title: Farm truck caught going 92 km/h: OPP
stories.summary: Ontario Provincial Police say a 49-year-old driver has been charged with careless driving after a farm truck was caught going 92 km/h.

stories.title: Blue Jays apologize to Muslim community and fans in wake of Santander’s posts
stories.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays apologized Thursday to the Muslim community and the team's fans for the "pain and harm" caused by outfielder Anthony Santander's social media posts.

stories.title: Four arrested, 220 charges laid in Cape Breton organized crime probe
stories.summary: The Cape Breton police probe began in July 2025 when police were called to find a stolen vehicle that was tracked to a property in Florence, N.S.

stories.title: Ontario career college forced into layoffs as student funding stalls
stories.summary: A school that says it plays by the rules warns that continuing to withhold student funding hurts Ontario’s workforce and could put good actors out of business.

stories.title: Leafs undone by more mistakes in 5th straight loss
stories.summary: Auston Matthews saw a familiar script unfold.

stories.title: Toronto orthodox priest criticized for accepting medal from Putin
stories.summary: The Ukrainian Canadian Congress said it was disgraceful that Father Vladimir Malchenko shook hands with Putin two days after Russia bombed a school in Ukraine, killing 55.

stories.title: Boldy’s hat trick sends Leafs to 5th straight loss
stories.summary: Matt Boldy completed his second hat trick of the season and the sixth of his career early in the third period as the Minnesota Wild resigned the Toronto Maple Leafs to a fifth straight regulation home loss with a 5-2 victory Thursday.

stories.title: Ontario to cap OSAP growth at career colleges following massive increases
stories.summary: The legislation is set to include the as-yet undefined cap, limit OSAP funding to in-person and hybrid programs at those institutions and require them to have a physical location.
